extension.description:
In the Harmonised indices of consumer prices (HICP), item weights are assigned to all goods and services as well as special aggregates, determining their share in the calculation of the higher-level indices. They are updated annually and for each country and year, the item weights add up to 1,000.

Please note that this dataset is discontinued and replaced by prc_hicp_iw
